heading: Your values, in orbit
lead: For hotels, commercial buildings, art galleries, botanical gardens, and the landscape and architectural firms who shape them. A Celestial Mechanics orrery is a piece of interactive art that tells your story in brass and light, and gives people a reason to come back.
pointsHeading: Art that works as hard as you do

points.title: A landmark people seek out
points.text: Lobbies, atriums and gardens become destinations. Guests photograph it, share it and return with friends.

points.title: Your story, told in brass and light
points.text: Curiosity, precision, a long view of the future: we design each piece to reflect and reinforce what your organisation stands for.

points.title: Made for the space-minded
points.text: For companies in aerospace, astronomy and the new space economy, there is no more fitting emblem than the solar system itself.

startingPoint.heading: A starting point
startingPoint.text: One of the configurations we'd suggest for a lobby or atrium. Use it as inspiration, or as the first sketch of your own.

closing.heading: Give your space a centre of gravity.
closing.text: Tell us about your building, your guests and your brand.
